item: GET side effects with data: the 74 routes that answered 4xx on an empty database are driven on a seeded corpus under the same monitors
summary: Seeds one row of each kind (source+group+metadata, article, law document with two revisions, watched wiki page with two revisions, commodity prices, edition, import report, custody entry) and drives 53 of the 74 GETs that answered 4xx on an empty DB with valid requests, under the first file's socket/thread/program/file/SQL-write/data_version monitors and tables; 21 are listed as not driven with a reason (POST-job artifacts, lane stores a download fills). Found no new effect (nvidia-smi probe on the bulletin editions is already allowed). Commodity correlation is profile-dependent (73 on Core-only). Also extracts _file_and_thread_problems for reuse and adds the lesson on two-profile route floors and walk order.
